pages.title: Three Colors, One World
pages.text: Reconstruct an image by channels; glass frames display the result and color film enables more experiments.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Expose through the three matching glass filters. Put Tinted Glass above the Lightroom, choose Chromatic mode and reuse one Chromatic Sheet through all three prints.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Photograph the subject through Red, Green and Blue glass-pane filters. Record stronger channel tints for chromatic reconstruction.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place Tinted Glass above the Lightroom, select Chromatic mode and reuse its Chromatic Sheet through red, green and blue prints. Combine three printed channels into a Photograph.
